[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Jiprin Kosh''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] serving the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. Captain Kosh commanded a naval force that took part in the [[Invasion of the Trian system|invasion]] the [[Trian system/Legends|Trian system]], where they were opposed by the [[Trianii Rangers]]. Fifteen [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] attack [[Starship/Legends|ships]] surrounded the invasion force and left them dead in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] after destroying [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and motivator systems. Captain Kosh broadcast offers of surrender, but the Trianii boarded their vessel and slaughtered their way to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="EGTAS" />

Taking Kosh and the command staff [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], the Trianii transported them to their lead vessel. Kosh was forced, on their knees, to account for their presence in the Trian system and then to apologize for the intrusion. Following this, Kosh and their staff were returned to their own ship and allowed to leave, carrying a warning back to the Corporate Sector Authority not to test the Trianii further. Kosh recommended that their superiors took note of the warning and heeded what the Trianii said.<ref name="EGTAS" />
